acceptedClaims.statement: Append-only correction of canonical transaction 1075dd02e8f83427a17b3f9f1391dfbb9e6d0a82, which is a corrective/provenance reference rather than a mathematical premise: for the two exact rational 2x4x4x9 auxiliary laws vendored from the pinned Huang--Liu--Liu certificate, an exhaustive standard-library scan evaluates all 2 * 4^9 = 524,288 deterministic maps of the nine source input labels to the four half-skew BSSC two-use super-inputs. Outward entropy intervals prove that the maximum half-weight Marton value over this finite family lies in [0.5451904011322205365, 0.5451904011322206215] bits and hence is strictly below 2 L_RTD. Source row 7 and base-four map ID 243761, namely (1,0,3,0,0,2,3,2,3), give the certified lower endpoint. No value within that enclosure is asserted to greater precision. This is a fixed-law deterministic-map family only: it excludes stochastic relabelings, changes to the auxiliary laws, mixtures or continuations, local-search campaigns, an unrestricted Marton-additivity theorem, and a capacity converse.
